reasoning: Resolution criteria use a 10-year window: 100+ offensive detonations on or near populated areas reliably produce >1M deaths through blast, fire, fallout and famine; published modeling shows even immediate fire deaths reach hundreds of thousands to millions. Near-certain conditional on the trigger.

Even worst-case nuclear-winter models do not predict literal zero humans; geographically dispersed and southern-hemisphere populations survive famine and cooling. Total extinction within 50 years is a deep-tail outcome, not the median, even at >1,000 detonations.

Below 400M means a ~95% die-off; nuclear-winter famine models put billions at risk but the median outcome leaves well over 1 billion survivors. A collapse to <400M is a plausible but minority catastrophic-tail scenario.

Conditional on offensive detonations. Limited-use, demonstration, or counterforce scenarios target sparse areas, but any large exchange heavily targets cities, and small-N realizations (e.g., 1-2 detonations on a city) push the fraction toward 1. Very wide and roughly centered.

Conditional on a direct US-Russia war (1,000+ mutual battle deaths) occurring by 2050; timing is roughly uniform over the window with mild front-loading given current tensions and the February 2026 lapse of New START guardrails.

Conditional on some fatal offensive detonation occurring somewhere by 2050; most plausible scenarios are regional (India-Pakistan, the Russia-Ukraine theater, Middle East), and a strike causing immediate fatalities on the US homeland is a minority of those conditional paths.

Non-state actors have never detonated a nuclear device; acquisition or improvised construction of a working bomb remains extremely difficult and the window to 2030 is short. Specific unprecedented event in a narrow window stays very low.

Nearly all plausible first-use scenarios (Russia-Ukraine, India-Pakistan, Korea, Middle East) arise from an ongoing or recent conventional conflict between nuclear and adversary states. A bolt-from-the-blue, inadvertent, or accidental detonation absent conventional fighting is the minority path.
